input: Find overnight, sleepaway and residential summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Weaverville, Woodfin, Leicester, Candler, Barnardsville, Marshall, Mars Hill and Hot Springs, NC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: overnight summer camp Weaverville Barnardsville North Carolina 2026

candidates.note: Residential Christian summer camps for middle- and high-school students; 2026 summer trips confirmed.

candidates.name: Glory Ridge
candidates.note: Weeklong residential summer mission programs for church youth groups, including home-repair service projects.
